en.hubeali: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Yazeed who said,
‘Whenever if a person from the household is stung by a snake or a scorpion, heasws said: ‘Make him drink Suweyq of the apples’.
en.sarwar: 8. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yazid who has said the following: “
Whenever a poisonous thing like snake or scorpion would bite anyone in the family he (the Imam) would say, ‘Make him drink sawiq of apples.’”
